turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to a relative.
I can’t share the delivery address without verifying the order. Please ask your relative to contact us with the order number and the email they used at checkout.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want the delivery address.
I couldn’t verify the order with that email, so I can’t share the delivery address. Please ask your relative to check the order number and contact us using the email they used at checkout.

error.message: No order matches that order number and email. Ask the customer to check both.
